nodes.name: priya unlocks prop cabinet
nodes.description: Priya uses a small key from her lanyard to unlock the prop cabinet during dress rehearsal.
evidence: PRIYA approaches the prop cabinet and unlocks it with a SMALL KEY from her lanyard.

nodes.name: priya retrieves prop pistol
nodes.description: Priya removes a gold-painted prop pistol from the cabinet and brings it to Leon in the wings.
evidence: She removes a GOLD-PAINTED PROP PISTOL and brings it to Leon in the wings.

nodes.name: leon compares pistol weight
nodes.description: Leon checks the weight of the gold-painted pistol and notes that it feels the same as the previous version.
evidence:
LEON
(checking the weight)
Feels the same.

nodes.name: priya explains pistol replacement
nodes.description: Priya explains that properties replaced the silver pistol with a gold one because it reads better under stage lights.
evidence:
PRIYA
Properties said the silver was too reflective under stage lights. Gold reads better at distance.

nodes.name: leon pockets prop pistol
nodes.description: Leon puts the gold-painted pistol into his pocket after receiving it.
evidence: Leon pockets the gold-painted pistol.

nodes.name: oscar joins diana in front row
aliases: oscar joins diana in front row
nodes.description: Oscar settles into a front-row seat beside Diana in the otherwise empty house.
evidence: In the house, Oscar settles into a front-row seat beside Diana.

nodes.name: oscar worries about empty theater
nodes.description: Oscar quietly remarks on the emptiness of the six-hundred-seat theater, revealing concern about attendance.
evidence:
OSCAR
(low)
Six hundred seats and every one of them empty tonight.

nodes.name: diana expresses confidence for saturday
nodes.description: Diana reassures Oscar that the seats will not be empty on Saturday.
evidence:
DIANA
They will not be empty Saturday.

nodes.name: oscar voices hope for turnout
nodes.description: Oscar responds that he hopes Diana is right about the upcoming audience turnout.
evidence:
OSCAR
Let us hope so.

nodes.name: diana ends act four rehearsal
nodes.description: After a tense dramatic section, Diana calls the end of Act Four and gives everyone a five-minute break.
evidence: At the end of a tense dramatic section:

DIANA
(calling to the stage)
End of Act Four! Take five, everyone!

nodes.name: cast breaks and leon sets down pistol
aliases: cast breaks and leon sets down pistol
nodes.description: As the cast relaxes during the break, Leon places the gold-painted pistol on the nearest prop table.
evidence: The cast relaxes on stage. Leon sets the gold-painted pistol on the nearest prop table.
